description: Read a composition's versions and accepted version. Use it when inspecting saved lineage; use design_preview to render, edit, compare or accept. Returns version metadata, latest and acceptance summary. Supply compositionId. Starts no preview host and returns no running URL. Full schema: oods://schemas/design_versions.input.json.

compositionId.description: An existing composition from design_compose; with no version, its latest version opens.

name: design_versions
title: Read Design Versions
